python-cipclient encodes digital join 1 as byte offset 0 in the join-high portion of the 7-byte 0x05 CIP data packet; packed_join = (cip_join//256) + ((cip_join%256)*256), high-bit set for value=0. CIP packet template for digital: `05 00 06 00 00 03 00` + 2-byte packed join.
Analog join 1 CIP packet template: `05 00 08 00 00 05 14` + 2-byte big-endian cip_join + 2-byte big-endian value. 16-bit unsigned 0-65535.

Serial join 1 packet template: `12 00 00 00 00 00 00 34` + 2-byte big-endian cip_join + `03` + ASCII bytes. Payload-length byte at offset 2 and inner-length at offset 6 are rewritten to `8+len(value)` and `4+len(value)` respectively.
